title: Base rate may decay at a slower rate than expected
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The base rate is used to calculate fees for redemptions and new issuances of debt, and its value decays over time and increases based on redemption volume.  On redemption, the decay on the base rate is calculated based on the number of minutes passed since the last fee operation.
